day_shape: 70 items: IDF announces capture of Beaufort Castle and Wadi al-Saluki in expanded south Lebanon ground op, one Givati soldier (Staff Sgt. Michael Tyukin, 21) killed by Hezbollah drone, sustained Hezbollah rocket/drone fire on Galilee and Kiryat Shmona, reports of Trump seeking amendments to draft US-Iran deal, no UK Parliament or OFAC items.

threads.label: IDF ground push into south Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF announced an operation in the Beaufort Ridge and Wadi al-Saluki area of southern Lebanon, saying troops captured the Crusader-built Beaufort Castle. The IDF Arabic spokesperson issued evacuation warnings for villages south of the Zahrani and the Litani, citing Hezbollah ceasefire violations.

threads.label: Hezbollah fire on northern Israel
threads.summary: Hezbollah launched repeated rocket and drone barrages at Kiryat Shmona, Karmiel, Nahariya, Safed, Shomera and the Galilee; the IDF reported interceptions and one drone impact in an open area in the Western Galilee. Staff Sgt. Michael Tyukin, 21, of the Givati Reconnaissance Unit was killed by a Hezbollah FPV drone in southern Lebanon, and Home Front Command shut schools along the border.

threads.label: Lebanese government response
threads.summary: Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam accused Israel of pursuing a "scorched-earth policy" against Hezbollah, per a Jerusalem Post report. In a separate statement carried by the IDF Arabic spokesperson, Salam said Lebanon did not choose war and was determined to protect the state.

threads.label: US-Iran deal negotiations
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post and Times of Israel reported Trump asked for several amendments to a draft US-Iran deal in a Friday Situation Room meeting, focused on the fate of Iran's uranium stockpile. Iranian MP Maliki told Defa Press that distrust of America remains and that the Strait of Hormuz and enrichment are non-negotiable.

threads.label: Hormuz shipping and US naval action
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported the US has allowed some Qatari tankers to cross Hormuz despite payments to Iran, and separately that the US said it struck a ship attempting to breach a blockade to reach Iran. CENTCOM posted imagery of sustained carrier flight operations and an F-35B landing on USS Tripoli in the Arabian Sea.

threads.label: Iran proxies and external links
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported on pressure on Iraqi militias to disarm, with Kataib Hezbollah's plan described as possibly symbolic, and Defa Press wrote on Muqtada al-Sadr ordering Saraya al-Salam's integration into the Iraqi state. Other reports flagged a New York case on an alleged Iran-linked terror campaign targeting Diaspora Jews and an NBC account, cited by JPost, of Chinese military technology aiding Iran during recent US-Iran fighting.

threads.label: Khamenei and regime domestic messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted messages marking the opening of the third year of the twelfth parliament, commemorations for the "martyrs of the family of Imam Shahid," and a statement calling the past year's conflicts a "grave miscalculation by the enemy." Defa Press and IRIB carried items on new parliamentary leadership oaths under Speaker Qalibaf, cultural messaging on Martyr Raisi, and a claimed "Hanza" hack releasing 2 million documents from a Holocaust victims support centre.

American economists emphasise that if the conflicts continue, staggering new costs will be incurred in the supply chain.
